comment: Inputs and outputs of normalize.json, checked by both tests/scripting-goldens.test.ts and ScriptingChecks (C#), so the two implementations agree.

cases.name: line endings
cases.input:
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

SELECT N'ab'
cases.output:
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

SELECT N'ab'

cases.name: passwords
cases.input:
CREATE LOGIN [x] WITH PASSWORD=N'a''b=c', DEFAULT_DATABASE=[master]
CREATE APPLICATION ROLE [r] WITH DEFAULT_SCHEMA = [dbo], PASSWORD = N'xyz'
cases.output:
CREATE LOGIN [x] WITH PASSWORD=N'<password>', DEFAULT_DATABASE=[master]
CREATE APPLICATION ROLE [r] WITH DEFAULT_SCHEMA = [dbo], PASSWORD=N'<password>'

cases.name: files
cases.input: ( NAME = N'x', FILENAME = N'/var/opt/mssql/data/x.mdf' , SIZE = 8192KB , MAXSIZE = UNLIMITED, FILEGROWTH = 65536KB )
cases.output: ( NAME = N'x', FILENAME = N'<path>' , SIZE = <n>KB , MAXSIZE = UNLIMITED, FILEGROWTH = <n>KB )

cases.name: audit
cases.input:
TO FILE 
(	FILEPATH = N'/var/opt/mssql/log/'
	,MAXSIZE = 0 MB
) WITH (QUEUE_DELAY = 1000, ON_FAILURE = CONTINUE, AUDIT_GUID = 'b734055a-cb1c-4674-ae00-ead288ff586f')
cases.output:
TO FILE 
(	FILEPATH = N'<path>'
	,MAXSIZE = 0 MB
) WITH (QUEUE_DELAY = 1000, ON_FAILURE = CONTINUE, AUDIT_GUID = '<guid>')
